subject: Board briefing: runbook, slide lock, and approval chain
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial draft + runbook for board briefing (Q3)

Team — attaching the first full draft of the board briefing and a short runbook with proposed timing for approvals. Key asks in this thread: please review slides relevant to your area and confirm final text or major callouts by EOD Fri (30 Jul).

Highlights: 
- Slide 3 (go-to-market metrics): Laura, please confirm ARR motion and the revised churn numbers.
- Slide 7 (Dedicated + Private traction): Markus, confirm the two new Dedicated deals and whether we can include logos.
- Slide 11 (ops resilience): Vivek, I added the incident SLA table — does it match what you agreed with SRE?

Runbook summary attached. My proposed approval chain: 
1) Content owners -> 2) Exec review (Laura + Markus + Vivek) -> 3) CEO approval -> 4) Legal final signoff (if any changes) -> 5) Slide lock and distribution to Board Secretariat.

Attachments: 2027Q3_board_brief_v1.pptx (draft), board_runbook_v1.pdf (timeline & roles), attendance_and_qs.csv (seed questions).

Olga
Olga Petrov
VP, Corporate Affairs
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial draft + runbook for board briefing (Q3)

Thanks, Olga. Quick notes after a pass: 
- Slide 3: ARR number is correct (59.2M ARR run-rate). Add a one-line footnote clarifying renewal timing.
- Slide 4 (FY forecast): the revenue ramp has one month misaligned — I commented on the slide with corrected-month tags.
- Customer highlights: please remove the small-case testimonial on slide 9 until we confirm permission from Alpha (Alison is copied below).

I can finalize the GTM text and visuals by Friday afternoon.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of GTM
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial draft + runbook for board briefing (Q3)

On Thu, Jul 29, 2027 at 10:03 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks, Olga. Quick notes after a pass: 
> - Slide 3: ARR number is correct (59.2M ARR run-rate). Add a one-line footnote clarifying renewal timing.

All — I confirmed the two Dedicated deals (LogiWave and Merchantly) may be included as "Customer highlights (Committed)"; legal okayed logos for both. I attached a short one-pager for Merchantly that we can pull a quote from.

Also: the Dedicated throughput chart (slide 7) needs the Y-axis label changed to "effective tokens / sec" — that will avoid confusion with capacity units in finance.

I'll review the ops slide with Vivek this afternoon and flag any divergence.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Product
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial draft + runbook for board briefing (Q3)

Thanks — quick ops confirmation after sync with SRE:
- Incident SLA table is accurate; added an extra row for "failover test cadence" (quarterly).
- We should not publish internal MTTR baselines; instead propose a directional statement: "reducing critical incident impact by 40% Y/Y".

I'm attaching the ops notes we agreed on. I also suggest a 15-minute Q&A slot allocated to "resilience & cost controls"; stakeholders: Vivek + Markus.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Infrastructure & Reliability
(attachment: ops_run_notes_20270802.pdf)
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Slide lock target and confirmed approvals — action required by 4pm PT

Team — thanks for the fast turns. Current plan: slide lock at 4pm PT today. Outstanding items (owners): 
- Laura: finalize GTM text + corrected revenue month (see comments) — due 12pm PT.
- Markus: final line for Dedicated traction slide and updated chart label — due 2pm PT.
- Vivek: replace MTTR specifics with directional wording and add failover cadence row — due 2:30pm PT.

I'll route the final pdf to CEO for signoff immediately after 4pm and to Legal if any wording changes are flagged. Once CEO signs, I'll send to Board Secretariat and Alison (Alpha).

If you can't meet these times, reply with exact block when you'll be available.

Olga
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final: locked board deck + runbook distributed to Board Secretariat

Folks — final update: CEO signed at 16:10 PT. I uploaded the locked PDF to the Drive folder and sent the package to Board Secretariat and Alison at Alpha. Links and package sent: Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-BoardDecks-2027Q3 ; DocuSign envelope initiated for the non-disclosure addendum (if required).

Attachments included in outbound package: 2027Q3_board_brief_final.pdf, board_runbook_v1.pdf, attendance_and_qs.csv.

Notes: Board Secretariat requested a one-page executive summary for their packet — I created it from slides 1-2 and attached as executive_summary_1p.pdf in the Drive folder.

Thanks everyone for the rapid turn.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Executive Ops
Redwood Inference
